prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: narrow-gauge isometric bridge kit source painting.
Image 1 is the exact grey block-out to EDIT. Image 2 is only the pastoral railway style board. Image 3 is only the same-material same-direction full-width deck reference: match its stone courses/coping or planks/kerb, but use image 1's NARROW geometry and framing.
Repaint the attached grey block-out as a finished game sprite in the style of the reference:
the pastoral railway style, smooth painted contours, broad colour clusters, three or four shades per
material, upper-left lighting. Keep the block-out's geometry exactly. Every outer edge, every
face and every angle stays where it is in the block-out, within a few pixels. Do not rotate,
move, scale, tilt or re-project anything. Edges running across the image keep their exact
2:1 slope (two pixels across for each pixel down); vertical edges stay vertical. The light
grey face is lit from above, the mid grey face faces the lower left, the dark grey face faces
the lower right. Keep that lighting. Same 1024 x 1024 canvas, same position. Only the object:
REAL RGBA transparent PNG, background alpha zero, solid surfaces opaque. No text, rails,
sleepers, water, ground, scenery, glow or cast shadow. No outline around the whole object.
Cut ends: where the block-out ends in a flat vertical cut, the painting ends in the same flat
cut, with no end cap, end post, end block, border or rounding. The next tile continues right
there, so any pattern (stone courses, coping stones, planks, rails, diagonals) must run
straight through the cut at the same height on both ends.
Exact geometry: 2:1 orthographic isometric; tile 64x32 game px; canvas 1024x1024; scale 8; centre at deck level (512,360). Projection (512+256*(x-y),360+128*(x+y)-8*z). Slab z=-5 to 0 (40 canvas px thick), along-track length 1 tile, across-track width 0.6 tile (half-width 0.30). Far wall 0.12 tile thick occupying across=-0.30 to -0.18. No near railing. No ballast, piers, braces, arches, supports, loose objects, end caps, end posts or scene.
Palette: forest #294638, moss #78804C, oat #E4D5B5, limestone #BCA98B, slate #626B6C, water #477B82, copper #A36B42. Smooth painted contours, no per-pixel noise, no stair-stepped pixel edges.
Track runs tile x NW to SE (upper left to lower right). Slab x=-0.5 to 0.5, y=-0.3 to 0.3. Top corners (460.8,257.6),(716.8,385.6),(563.2,462.4),(307.2,334.4). Near long side faces lower left. Far wall along y=-0.3.
Cream limestone bridge deck: dressed stone flags on slab and limestone parapet with flat coping on far edge, 5 game px high. Match reference stone courses and coping; restrained broad cream stone shades and joints.

edgeOffsets.method: For every face edge, 21 samples excluding vertices; shortest Euclidean distance to alpha>=128 silhouette boundary. Unsigned distances include internal face joins, which are labelled separately. No fitting or silhouette alteration.
